title: The Bitter Lesson
summary: Looking back over decades of AI research, the piece argues that general methods which scale with computation, namely search and learning, have always eventually beaten approaches that build in human knowledge, and that researchers should build meta-methods that discover rather than encode what we think we know.

title: Current AIs out-persuade professionals in lab settings but (probably) not in the world
summary: The author argues that experiments show AIs beating professional humans at narrow persuasion tasks, but real-world evidence suggests broad AI persuasion sits between median human and median professional level.
